title: 3D Histogram with Categories and Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that renders an interactive 3D histogram with category-based bars and full undo/redo support.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (8, 6, 8) looking at the origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8.
- Add OrbitControls for camera rotation.
- Use a dark background color (#1a1a2e).
- Add a grid helper (size 10, divisions 10) on the ground plane.

## Histogram Data & Bars
- Initialize 5 categories: ['Sales', 'Marketing', 'Engineering', 'Design', 'Support'] with initial values [4, 7, 10, 5, 8].
- For each category, create a 3D box (bar) with width=1.0, depth=1.0, and height equal to the category value (1 unit = 1 value unit).
- Space bars along the X-axis with 1.8 unit center-to-center spacing, centered around x=0. So positions: x = -3.6, -1.8, 0, 1.8, 3.6.
- Each bar sits on the ground (y = height/2).
- Color each bar differently: Sales=#e74c3c, Marketing=#3498db, Engineering=#2ecc71, Design=#f39c12, Support=#9b59b6.
- Use MeshStandardMaterial with metalness=0.3 and roughness=0.7.

## Category Labels
- Below each bar, add a text label (use a canvas texture on a small plane, or DOM overlay). Show the category name.
- Above each bar, show the current numeric value as a floating label.

## Interaction: Select & Modify Bars
- Clicking on a bar selects it (highlight with emissive color #ffffff at 0.3 intensity). Only one bar selected at a time. Clicking empty space deselects.
- When a bar is selected:
  - Press ArrowUp to increment its value by 1 (max 15).
  - Press ArrowDown to decrement its value by 1 (min 0).
  - The bar height animates smoothly (lerp over 300ms) to the new value.
  - Each value change is recorded in an undo stack.

## Undo/Redo System
- Maintain an undo stack and redo stack.
- Each entry stores: { categoryIndex, oldValue, newValue }.
- Press 'Z' (or Ctrl+Z) to undo the last change. The bar animates to its previous value.
- Press 'Y' (or Ctrl+Y) to redo. The bar animates to the redone value.
- When a new change is made, clear the redo stack.
- Maximum undo history: 20 entries.

## HUD / DOM Elements
- Add a top-left HUD panel (DOM overlay) showing:
  - 'Selected: [CategoryName]' or 'Selected: None'
  - 'Undo Stack: [count]' and 'Redo Stack: [count]'
  - Total sum of all bar values: 'Total: [sum]'
- Add two DOM buttons with ids 'btn-undo' and 'btn-redo' that also trigger undo/redo.
- Add a 'Reset' button with id 'btn-reset' that resets all bars to initial values (this action itself is undoable as a batch).

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- categoryNames: array of 5 strings
- categoryValues: array of 5 current numeric values
- selectedIndex: index of selected bar or -1 if none
- undoStackSize: number of entries in undo stack
- redoStackSize: number of entries in redo stack
- totalSum: sum of all category values
- barHeights: array of 5 actual bar mesh scaleY or geometry height values (the visual height, which may differ during animation)
- lastAction: string, one of 'none', 'increment', 'decrement', 'undo', 'redo', 'reset', 'select', 'deselect'
- animating: boolean, true if any bar is currently animating

Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.

## Animation
- When a bar value changes, smoothly animate its height over ~300ms using lerp.
- During animation, set animating=true. When done, set animating=false.
- Ensure bar y-position adjusts so the bar always sits on the ground plane.
physics_constraints: Bar heights must be non-negative (min 0) and capped at 15. Total sum must equal the sum of all categoryValues at all times. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous values. Bar y-position must equal height/2 (sitting on ground). No NaN values allowed in any state field.
